noAnchorGaps.concept: a market order fires at the current price
noAnchorGaps.quote: A market order fires right now at the current price — instant, but no price guarantee.
noAnchorGaps.why: move trade_setup_long exposes only entry/stop/target (L) anchors; there is no 'current price' / market-fill anchor to label, so this reference is genuinely undrawable.

notes: Only one CHART beat (placement, trade_setup_long). Its accumulated show already labels all three valid anchors — entry ('limit order — your entry'), stop ('stop — invalidation'), target ('limit — take profit') — plus risk/reward zones anchored to the valid 'entry' level. The limit ('rests below') and stop ('sits beneath your invalidation') references in the say are both already drawn, so no add. The only remaining locatable concept — the market order at current price — has no anchor in trade_setup_long (anchors: entry, stop, target only), so it is correctly a noAnchorGap, not an invented anchor. All other beats (intro, manage, recap) are CONCEPT (no chart). Auditor proposal confirmed; nothing added, nothing rejected.
